description: This file defines interfaces for a GStreamer Web Audio Player in the Rialto server component, including factory and player classes, with methods for controlling playback, setting capabilities, volume control, buffer writing, and querying queued bytes.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IGstWebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Interface for controlling a GStreamer Web Audio Player, including playback, volume, buffer management, and state notifications.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance for creating Web Audio Player objects.

methods.name: createGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new IGstWebAudioPlayer instance with the specified client and priority.

methods.name: setCaps
methods.description: Sets the capabilities (e.g., MIME type and configuration) for the audio source.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the current volume level for the pipeline.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffers to the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Notifies the end of stream to the pipeline.

methods.name: getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes queued for playback.
